target_customer: Veterinary oncology clinics and dog owners whose pets have cancer; sold through veterinarians
problem: Dogs with cancer mostly get generic chemotherapy; tumor genomic testing and targeted therapy options were not easily available to veterinarians.
business_model: Fee per genomic test and care service sold through veterinary clinics; does not prescribe or supply drugs per its site
product_category: Veterinary precision oncology (genomic testing plus AI therapy recommendations)

founders.name: Christina Lopes
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as Founder; TechCrunch (2019-01-23) and Veterinary Practice News (2020-11-06) call her founder or cofounder and CEO. Education and past employers not given by sources opened.

technical_complexity.rationale: Required tumor sequencing, a curated database linking mutations to drugs and veterinary workflows for dogs, which combines genomics, software and clinical knowledge.

defensibility.rationale: Real-world outcome data from hundreds of oncologists accumulates and the company later obtained a patent per press coverage; sequencing itself is available to rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large diagnostics firms partnered or resold rivals' tests (Antech resold SearchLight DNA in 2022) while IDEXX collaborated with FidoCure; none acquired it through 2026.

market_need_then: Owners spend heavily on dogs with cancer and the company framed targeted therapy as an underserved option for veterinary oncologists; seed investors from a human bio fund backed this in January 2019.

branding.domain_note: Uses fidocure.com; corporate entity is One Health Company, Inc.

identity.logo: Blue palette per Brandfetch listing; design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm mission language about dog lovers and scientists

branding.brand_signature: FidoCure registered trademark (filed January 2019) and Fetch AI engine naming

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable, friendly product name signals the dog audience and is trademarked, but no source shows community or press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: FidoCure, made by One Health Company, raised a 5 million dollar seed from Andreessen Horowitz's bio fund in January 2019 and a 10 million dollar Series A in November 2020 led by Polaris and Borealis. It reports a network of over 140 clinics and 180 oncologists and partnerships with IDEXX and Thrive. No exit or shutdown was found. Later rounds appear in aggregators with conflicting totals.
notes: Competitor list is empty: searches found canine genomic firms only from 2020 onward (Vidium launched 2020, PetDx OncoK9 later), none dated near the 2018 batch. PitchBook lists a 15M Series B in 2024 and 32.1M total, CB Insights 16.62M; aggregator figures that conflict, so not recorded as rounds. Veterinary Practice News calls the 2020 round additional Series A funding, so an earlier Series A may exist and the 2019 seed total is not fully reconciled. A search summary named Benjamin Lewis as a co-founder but the page was not opened, so he is not listed.
